block.text: Now that we're done executing the code in the constructor, we return to FlightTest to continue executing the line of code we were looking at before. The stack frame for the Flight constructor gets deleted because we're done executing that code, so we don't need to keep its memory around and take up space. After calling the Flight constructor and creating the Flight object on the heap, we assign the memory address of this object to united1, which updates the reference variable in the FlightTest object on the heap.
